patterns.what_worked: Establishing the engine rule for HookScript from Blizzard's OWN shipped code (SkillFrame has no Scripts element yet Blizzard hooks its OnShow; PTR_IssueReporter is a template-less CreateFrame yet Blizzard hooks its OnHide) turned the highest-severity class from a guess into a per-branch table. Extracting the 2864 generated API-doc files per branch and then doing a whole-tree Interface/ sweep separately caught that the classic branches' API docs are an incomplete set, which would have produced a false absence report.
patterns.what_was_hard: Deciding whether 'not in the generated API docs' means 'not in the client' on the classic branches, and separating the classic pair's byte-identical files from their behaviour. Also keeping the four per-branch client claims (five clients, not two families) straight across roughly 200 mirror greps.
patterns.skill_gap: I did not have a mechanical way to prove the engine-default frame script set (OnShow/OnHide/OnUpdate/...) from the mirror alone; I had to infer it from two pieces of Blizzard shipping code. An explicit engine-side source would settle it.
